Variants and sizes

Inventory rows: Tall drawer.

When to use

The filters drawer is the second drawer listings opens and the only one that holds more than fits. The Filters button on the finder raises it. It holds Drone type and the price range, and at the built frame it has 0px to scroll. The scroll body exists for when zones are added later. Applied values come back to the home screen as filter chips above Filters (see in-page tabs), and a tap on a chip removes that filter.

Apply filters writes the chips and closes. Clear all empties every zone and closes. The scrim and Escape close without applying. The two actions sit side by side because neither is a cancel. The stacked-cancel rule from HIG · Action sheets applies to a Cancel / Done pair, and this is not one. The four drone type names (Quadcopter · Hexacopter · FPV · Fixed-wing) are equipment words. They depart from voice P4 and P1 on the designer's decision.

Sources: DESIGN.md § The search home (Drawers) · inventory.md § 1 Tall drawer · microcopy.md § listings, Filters drawer · ui/kit.html § Filters drawer

Rule and anti-rule

Do

Two actions that each change the result, Clear all and Apply filters, side by side at the drawer's foot. Apply filters is the drawer's one green control.

Don’t

Cancel and Done split across one row. A pair that includes a cancel stacks one per row, Cancel over Done, the way every Done/Cancel drawer does; see stacked actions. A drawer whose content fits without scrolling does not need --tall. Use the plain sheet.
